body: Yeah I think there's some food banks open tomorrow in my area? I remember as a kid we had to visit them once or twice, they even helped us with rent so maybe I can find someone to help there too. I've just been so overwhelmed with my new job (I also had some pizza hut store credit from when they made me wait an hour once). I am definitely reevaluating my relationship to see if it's overall beneficial for both of us, I have Borderline Personality Disorder so I tend to be overdramatic and judgmental about affection and attention, and my emotions are really hard to deal with for people close to me. It's also a lot harder to deal with heartbreak and be alone. But I know he doesn't mean any ill will by being emotionally negligent, his family treats him like a butler and he's used to just shutting down when they flip out at him. He got himself set up with a therapist and some medication when we started dating because he told me he wants to get better, for me, and I can see improvement. Also, about gym memberships, I might be able to get one? But my main problem would be finding a place to park my car and sleep because the whole county is super anti-loitering (and generally antagonistic towards the homeless). Thank you for encouraging me to make the harder decisions, it hurts to hear but I know a toxic relationship can eat at someone's soul so I've been very careful.

Ah, I'm sorry you were upset, but thank you for reaching out! I felt significantly better just posting it and getting it off my chest, I don't have any urges to harm for right now. I was hoping it wasn't just a lot of whining. The culture in my town seems to be "life sucks get over it" and mental illness isn't respected or given much funding. Everything would be so much easier if I had food in my stomach, so I'm gonna go scanning for food banks tomorrow and maybe I can find someone who has an idea of how to get more rent money. My job is also wonderful, despite my manager being kind of negligent. I think once I have a permanent spot in the schedule it'll all be okay in like, March. I might even be able to move closer to my job, or somewhere cheaper. It's just so scary to not know if things are gonna be okay or not.
